sections.name: Intro - metronome kick drum, one chiming delay guitar, a girl humming far away
Verse 1 - male British voice, sing-spoken, close to the mic
Verse 3 - male, warmer, the drums begin to move
Spoken - soft young girl's voice, reading her letter
Bridge - building, drums driving, choir rising
Final Chorus - key lift, full band, the whole congregation
Outro - the band falls away, metronome kick, one guitar

lines.text: Five in the morning, before the cockerel,
lines.section: Verse 1 - male British voice, sing-spoken, close to the mic

lines.text: She's on the road with a yellow can.
lines.section: Verse 1 - male British voice, sing-spoken, close to the mic

lines.text: Red dust, bare feet, an hour each way,
lines.section: Verse 1 - male British voice, sing-spoken, close to the mic

lines.text: And it's heavier coming home.
lines.section: Verse 1 - male British voice, sing-spoken, close to the mic

lines.text: She's seven. Same as my eldest.
lines.section: Verse 1 - male British voice, sing-spoken, close to the mic

lines.text: The water's brown. She drinks it anyway.
lines.section: Verse 1 - male British voice, sing-spoken, close to the mic

lines.text: Her brother coughs all night.
lines.section: Verse 1 - male British voice, sing-spoken, close to the mic

lines.text: She walks the long way round the school
lines.section: Verse 1 - male British voice, sing-spoken, close to the mic

lines.text: And doesn't go in.
lines.section: Verse 1 - male British voice, sing-spoken, close to the mic

lines.text: Seven in the morning, green and pleasant land,
lines.section: Verse 2 - male, sing-spoken

lines.text: The boiler hums, the tap runs hot,
lines.section: Verse 2 - male, sing-spoken

lines.text: My boys are fighting over cereal
lines.section: Verse 2 - male, sing-spoken

lines.text: And I'm moaning that the Wi-Fi's slow.
lines.section: Verse 2 - male, sing-spoken

lines.text: Two pairs of school shoes by the door,
lines.section: Verse 2 - male, sing-spoken

lines.text: Two lunchboxes, two coats, two futures,
lines.section: Verse 2 - male, sing-spoken

lines.text: And her face came up on my phone again,
lines.section: Verse 2 - male, sing-spoken

lines.text: And I scrolled on by.
lines.section: Verse 2 - male, sing-spoken

lines.text: Once, I said I'd do it later.
lines.section: Pre-Chorus - building, guitar climbing

lines.text: Twice, I said what difference can one man make.
lines.section: Pre-Chorus - building, guitar climbing

lines.text: Three times I scrolled on by,
lines.section: Pre-Chorus - building, guitar climbing

lines.text: And somewhere a cockerel cried.
lines.section: Pre-Chorus - building, guitar climbing

lines.text: Holy, holy,
lines.section: Chorus - soaring, full voice

lines.text: Wake me from my sleep.
lines.section: Chorus - soaring, full voice

lines.text: Every face that I scrolled past
lines.section: Chorus - soaring, full voice

lines.text: Was You, looking at me.
lines.section: Chorus - soaring, full voice

lines.text: (Will you sponsor me?)
lines.section: Chorus - soaring, full voice

lines.text: With the help of God, I will.
lines.section: Chorus - soaring, full voice

lines.text: (Will you sponsor me?)
lines.section: Chorus - soaring, full voice

lines.text: With the help of God, I will.
lines.section: Chorus - soaring, full voice

lines.text: A pound a day. A pound a day.
lines.section: Verse 3 - male, warmer, the drums begin to move

lines.text: Less than the coffee going cold beside me.
lines.section: Verse 3 - male, warmer, the drums begin to move

lines.text: It doesn't go in her pocket, it goes in the ground:
lines.section: Verse 3 - male, warmer, the drums begin to move

lines.text: A well, a nurse, a classroom roof,
lines.section: Verse 3 - male, warmer, the drums begin to move

lines.text: And four more children drinking there beside her.
lines.section: Verse 3 - male, warmer, the drums begin to move

lines.text: My son drew her a lion in felt-tip,
lines.section: Verse 3 - male, warmer, the drums begin to move

lines.text: Folded it into a padded envelope
lines.section: Verse 3 - male, warmer, the drums begin to move

lines.text: With stickers and a pack of crayons,
lines.section: Verse 3 - male, warmer, the drums begin to move

lines.text: And twelve weeks later, through the letterbox:
lines.section: Verse 3 - male, warmer, the drums begin to move

lines.text: A house, a blue door, and a sun with a face.
lines.section: Verse 3 - male, warmer, the drums begin to move

lines.text: Dear friend. I am well. The water is clean now.
lines.section: Spoken - soft young girl's voice, reading her letter

lines.text: I go to school. I am learning to write.
lines.section: Spoken - soft young girl's voice, reading her letter

lines.text: I drew you my tree.
lines.section: Spoken - soft young girl's voice, reading her letter

lines.text: Holy, holy,
lines.section: Chorus - soaring, full voice

lines.text: Wake me from my sleep.
lines.section: Chorus - soaring, full voice

lines.text: Every face that I scrolled past
lines.section: Chorus - soaring, full voice

lines.text: Was You, looking at me.
lines.section: Chorus - soaring, full voice

lines.text: (Will you sponsor me?)
lines.section: Chorus - soaring, full voice

lines.text: With the help of God, I will.
lines.section: Chorus - soaring, full voice

lines.text: (Will you sponsor me?)
lines.section: Chorus - soaring, full voice

lines.text: With the help of God, I will.
lines.section: Chorus - soaring, full voice

lines.text: You don't have to sing my song
lines.section: Bridge - building, drums driving, choir rising

lines.text: To know that this is wrong.
lines.section: Bridge - building, drums driving, choir rising

lines.text: You don't need my God to see a child
lines.section: Bridge - building, drums driving, choir rising

lines.text: Who's been waiting forty days.
lines.section: Bridge - building, drums driving, choir rising

lines.text: But I see a table long as the sky,
lines.section: Bridge - building, drums driving, choir rising

lines.text: Laid on a mountain in the light,
lines.section: Bridge - building, drums driving, choir rising

lines.text: Every nation, every tribe and tongue,
lines.section: Bridge - building, drums driving, choir rising

lines.text: No colour, no border, no first, no last,
lines.section: Bridge - building, drums driving, choir rising

lines.text: And a chair beside her with your name on.
lines.section: Bridge - building, drums driving, choir rising

lines.text: Let the little children come.
lines.section: Bridge - building, drums driving, choir rising

lines.text: Let the little children come.
lines.section: Bridge - building, drums driving, choir rising

lines.text: Whoever welcomes one of these
lines.section: Bridge - building, drums driving, choir rising

lines.text: Welcomes Me.
lines.section: Bridge - building, drums driving, choir rising

lines.text: Holy, holy,
lines.section: Final Chorus - key lift, full band, the whole congregation

lines.text: Wake us from our sleep.
lines.section: Final Chorus - key lift, full band, the whole congregation

lines.text: Every face that we scrolled past
lines.section: Final Chorus - key lift, full band, the whole congregation

lines.text: Was You, looking at us.
lines.section: Final Chorus - key lift, full band, the whole congregation

lines.text: (Will you sponsor me?)
lines.section: Final Chorus - key lift, full band, the whole congregation

lines.text: With the help of God, we will.
lines.section: Final Chorus - key lift, full band, the whole congregation

lines.text: (Will you sponsor me?)
lines.section: Final Chorus - key lift, full band, the whole congregation

lines.text: With the help of God, we will.
lines.section: Final Chorus - key lift, full band, the whole congregation

lines.text: (Will you sponsor me?)
lines.section: Final Chorus - key lift, full band, the whole congregation

lines.text: We will. We will.
lines.section: Final Chorus - key lift, full band, the whole congregation

lines.text: (Will you sponsor me?)
lines.section: Final Chorus - key lift, full band, the whole congregation

lines.text: With the help of God, we will.
lines.section: Final Chorus - key lift, full band, the whole congregation

lines.text: (Will you sponsor me?)
lines.section: Final Chorus - key lift, full band, the whole congregation

lines.text: We will. We will.
lines.section: Final Chorus - key lift, full band, the whole congregation

lines.text: Five in the morning, and the cockerel crows.
lines.section: Outro - the band falls away, metronome kick, one guitar

lines.text: She's on the road with a reading book.
lines.section: Outro - the band falls away, metronome kick, one guitar

lines.text: The yellow can is full beside the door,
lines.section: Outro - the band falls away, metronome kick, one guitar

lines.text: And she's running.
lines.section: Outro - the band falls away, metronome kick, one guitar

lines.text: I will.
